name: Berlin
about: Summer brings long days and outdoor culture, winter is cold and dark but atmospheric with Christmas markets.
overview: A vast, endlessly creative capital of world-class museums, street art, and a nightlife scene that runs till dawn.
costOverview: Transit, coffee, and street food all stay genuinely cheap — Berlin remains one of Western Europe's better-value capitals.

specialSeasons.text: Christmas markets fill squares across the city with mulled wine and crafts.
